paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
The use of unmodified BFGS at differentiable points of a nonsmooth objective
was investigated systematically by Lewis and Overton~\cite{LO}.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Locally Lipschitz nonsmooth objectives; actual gradients where available; full inverse update; Armijo/weak Wolfe.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: No general convergence theorem inferred from experiments.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
Guo and Lewis proved convergence for the Euclidean norm in arbitrary finite
dimension~\cite[Corollary~4.2]{GL18}, using smooth convex replacements and
Powell's convergence theorem.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Any SPD initialization; nonzero differentiable accepted gradients; fixed 0<mu<nu<1; full BFGS.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Our extension is not a first proof of norm convergence.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
Their result for $u^2+|v|$ gives a subsequence
approaching the nonsmooth axis~\cite[Corollary~4.4]{GL18}.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: The cited paper does not prove full convergence to zero.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
Xie and W\"achter ruled out infinite admissible runs
for the maximum of two affine functions with independent linear parts,
identifying an unbounded descent direction when acceptable steps cease to exist
\preprintcite[Theorem~IV.1]{XW}.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: n≥2; |x1|+sum_{i≥2}xi up to invertible affine transformation; arbitrary SPD; positive steps; accepted x1 nonzero; 0<c1<c2<1.
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Finite outer-run termination with unbounded final descent ray.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Not a bound on trial evaluations of a particular detection procedure.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
Gebken's local criticality theorem~\cite[Theorem~3.1]{BG} instead assumes
convergence of the iterates and specified spectral and gradient-difference
annihilation behavior of the quasi-Newton matrices.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: (A2): positive barycentric representation and affine independence at unique global minimum, bounded nontrivial sublevel. (B1): infinite nonzero gradients, iterate limit, all selections recurrent, complementary eigenvalue bounds, Hk times branch-gradient differences tends to zero.
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Sufficiently near starts have critical assumed limits.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Matrix convergence is not itself assumed; do not substitute that stronger shorthand.

paper_literature_claims.source_locator: Nocedal Section 5; Guo–Lewis Theorem 3.1 for Powell statement
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Positive-definite BFGS matrices and positive secant curvature for the algebra; convergence theorems have additional smoothness/curvature hypotheses.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: No claim that the precise adjacent-degree inequality was located; original Powell/Byrd–Nocedal proof access limited.

paper_literature_claims.source_locator: Prior audit: AW paper Appendices C–D; exact-search article separate DOI
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Smooth strongly convex regimes; theorem-specific constants and further smoothness in the cited papers.
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Non-asymptotic convergence estimates using matrix potentials.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: No rate transferred to a nonsmooth objective; current-run proof reading not claimed.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
Mascarenhas constructed
smooth nonconvex BFGS failures and developed methods for prescribing an orbit
and realizing it by a smooth objective~\cite{NEG_M04,NEG_M07,NEG_M14}.
paper_literature_claims.source_locator: 2004 Theorems 1–4; 2006 author manuscript introduction and Section 7; 2014 prior audit
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Special prescribed initial states; smooth nonconvex objectives; exact-search choices (with extra decrease conditions in relevant constructions).
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Nonconvergent/nonstationary cyclic behavior and extension-based realization.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: No generic basin claimed; does not establish our convex, fixed-rule, all-query, local-minimizer quantifiers.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
Lewis and Zhang gave a nonsmooth inexact-search example converging to a
stationary point with directions of linear descent~\cite{NEG_LZ15}.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Nonsmooth objective; inexact search; particular example.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Not convex nonstationarity; abstract supports this restrained comparison, not complete theorem audit.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
The scaled memoryless method studied by Asl and Overton can fail on a convex
piecewise-linear objective~\cite{NEG_AO21}; its update differs from full BFGS.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: n≥2; a|x1|+sum_{i≥2}xi; a≥2sqrt(n−1); scaled memoryless update; accepted x1 nonzero; tk≤2 for k≥1, as with cited routine.
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Values bounded below along a run despite objective unbounded below; nonoptimal limiting point.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Does not transfer to full BFGS; no generic robustness claim added.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
The exact-search nonsmooth examples of Lewis and Overton
\preprintcite{NEG_LO08} allow subgradient selections and null steps.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Exact line minimization extended using suitable Clarke subgradient; alpha=0 possible.
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Conceptual nonsmooth BFGS examples using these conventions.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Our accepted and queried points have gradients and accepted steps are positive.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence: Local convex cocoercivity is a Baillon--Haddad consequence~\cite{WW};
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Convex differentiable function on open convex Hilbert domain; L-Lipschitz derivative.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: 2023 publication verified; numbering belongs to inspected preprint.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
active-manifold and partial-smoothness geometry is developed in
\cite{geom_Lewis2002,LL}, and stratified subgradient projection underlies
the critical-value arguments of~\cite{BDLS}.
paper_literature_claims.source_locator: Lewis Theorem 6.1; LL version caution; BDLS Proposition 4/Lemma 8/Corollary 9 in 2006 preprint
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Partial smoothness for manifold geometry; lsc definability/Whitney transversality for projection.
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Common tangential subgradient projection and finite Clarke critical values.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: An affine-hull-zero deduction uses linearity of projection; it is not the printed Clarke-critical theorem. LL published proof not freshly obtained.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
The exact seed certificate uses the principle of preconditioned root
enclosure~\cite[Theorem~13.3]{NEG_RUMP10}, with its inequalities proved
explicitly here.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: C1 map; interval box X containing zero; translated box in domain; preconditioner R; -Rf(x0)+(I-RJf(x0+X))X lies inside int(X).
paper_literature_claims.source_conclusion_or_technique: Existence and uniqueness of enclosed root with nonsingular preconditioner.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Article must prove its own rational bounds; neither citation nor floating-point output proves the seed.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
This is the unit-first
bracketing implementation of Lewis--Overton~\cite[Algorithm~4.6]{LO}.
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: Unit trial; Armijo tested first; set upper/lower bracket then bisect/double.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: Published acceptance strict; next manuscript sentence establishes identical choices from strict margins.

paper_literature_claims.exact_manuscript_sentence:
The Hessian identity is the classical equivalent form of BFGS
\cite[Section~5]{FND_N92};
paper_literature_claims.relevant_assumptions: H positive definite; y^Ts positive; s=-alpha Hg.
paper_literature_claims.difference_or_scope_limit: The article also gives the algebraic multiplication proof.
